stories.title: Mike Lynch’s superyacht had unidentified vulnerability to high winds, report finds
summary: Bayesian, which sank off Sicily killing seven including tech tycoon, had not been fully assessed, say investigatorsThe superyacht Bayesian, which sank in a storm off Sicily killing seven people including the tech tycoon Mike Lynch and his teenage daughter, was vulnerable to knockdown but crew were not aware as it had never been assessed at anchor with its sails down, the final report from the UK’s Marine Accident Investigations Branch (MAIB) has said.The 56-metre (184ft) vessel was anchored near the fishing port of Porticello when it sank during a violent storm shortly before dawn on 19 August 2024.
